citations.text:
CPU: Optimize Latency of a Small Number of Complex Threads
  Five-Stage Instruction Pipeline

¡ Perfect Pipeline

   ¡ One instruction completes per cycle after filling
      the pipeline.

   ¡ No bubbles and maximum throughput.


¡ For N instructions and M stages:

   ¡  Total Cycles = M + N – 1

   ¡  Average throughput
     = N / (M + N - 1) instructions per cycle

   ¡  Instruction throughput per second
     Frequency * N / (M + N - 1)
